about.hero_subtitle: Over 20 years of excellence in providing premium auto parts solutions
about.story_description: D&W Myanmar Auto Parts was founded in 2004 in Yangon with a vision to provide premium quality auto parts to the Myanmar market. Starting at a time when quality parts were scarce, we recognized the critical importance of reliable components for vehicle safety and performance.
about.story_description2: Today, we stand as one of Myanmar's leading auto parts suppliers, partnering with renowned manufacturers and serving customers nationwide with an extensive catalog of genuine and OEM parts.
about.mission_description: To provide Myanmar's automotive community with premium quality parts at competitive prices, backed by exceptional service.
about.vision_description: To become Myanmar's premier auto parts destination, serving over 80% of the country's automotive parts market.
about.values_description: Our core values guide every decision we make and every interaction we have.
